caseName: Glenwood T. V., Inc. v. Ratner
caseNameFull: Glenwood T. V., Inc. v. Ratner, Commissioner, Department of Consumer Affairs of the City of New York

opinions.text: Appeal from Ct. App. N. Y. dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.
